description: This file defines a final class `HttpStatusCodeValueValidator` which extends `AbstractHeaderValueValidator`. Its purpose is to parse a CharSequence to an integer and verify if it corresponds to a known HTTP status code, throwing an exception if validation fails. It implements a singleton pattern for obtaining an instance of the validator.

classes.name: HttpStatusCodeValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class that validates if a CharSequence represents a known HTTP status code, as defined by HttpStatusCode enum.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HttpStatusCodeValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates whether the provided CharSequence value corresponds to a known HttpStatusCode, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into an int, assuming the value has already been validated as a proper integer string.
